prompt: Annotate this battle map. Mark each visible wooden or metal door leaf with a bright cyan (#00FFFF) straight line from jamb to jamb, about 8 pixels thick. Paint ONLY the overhead stone spans of open archways solid bright magenta (#FF00FF), covering the stone edge to edge. Paint the arch supports and adjoining standing masonry solid yellow (#FFFF00). An open archway has no door: keep its floor passage unmarked. Do not mark rubble, shadows, stairs, furniture or ordinary empty openings. Preserve the original map, exact framing and aspect ratio. No labels or invented structures.
